prompt:
Production cutout puppet parts sheet for the approved FROG WIZARD in the reference. This is NOT an expression sheet. Precisely SIX SEPARATE ISOLATED ARTWORK COMPONENTS, 3 columns x2 rows, each contained within its own equally sized cell with generous clear gap. Transparent background, no labels or text or grid. All components face FRONT, symmetrical enough to rig but charming imperfect ink. Same approved chunky flat SVG illustration style: turquoise frog, deep plum hat/scarf, cream spiral motifs, charcoal cloak, small golden diamond clasp. Bold organic near-black outlines and only 1-2 flat shadow shapes, no gradients, NO texture, no realistic rendering, no anime. LIMITED 12 flat colors total. Crisp clean contours.
TOP LEFT: the ENTIRE EMPTY WIZARD HAT ONLY, broad floppy crooked cone drooping right, wide dark underside brim, cream trim and two large cream spiral motifs, full hat silhouette including brim, with NO FACE, NO EYES, NO FROG, NO TIES. Enough deep dark hat interior so a separate frog head can overlap the underside.
TOP MIDDLE: HEADLESS BUST COSTUME ONLY. Broad squat charcoal cloak shoulders, large dark plum folded scarf/cowl wrapped around the neck opening, small gold diamond clasp at left of center. No head or arms/hands. Top neck opening large curved empty dark recess. Full shoulders contained. Bottom cleanly terminates at chest. Few tasteful bold flat folds.
TOP RIGHT: BLANK TURQUOISE FROG HEAD SHAPE ONLY. Wide lumpy soft rounded frog head with two raised soft bumps where eyes will be added, broad cheeks and rounded chin. NO EYES, NO PUPILS, NO MOUTH, NO NOSTRILS, NO HAT, NO CLOTHES. Unbroken teal skin face ready for rigged face features. One darker blue flat underside region, one subdued teal cheek color area only. Black perimeter contour. Large simple geometry, NOT detailed skin texture.
BOTTOM LEFT: one turquoise frog HAND in a loose curled/clasping pose, three thick rounded webbed fingers plus thumb, dark plum sleeve cuff and short wrist trailing DOWN. Hand upright. This is a separate clean cutout.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: one turquoise frog HAND with a single raised index finger for touching the chin, remaining fat webbed fingers curled, dark plum sleeve cuff and short wrist trailing DOWN. Hand upright.
BOTTOM RIGHT: one turquoise frog HAND with three broad round fingertip pads and a thumb SPLAYED wide in surprise, webbing between fingers, dark plum sleeve cuff and short wrist trailing DOWN. Hand upright.
Each hand is viewed palm toward viewer with a slight three-quarter angle, consistent scale/style. Each top object should fill about 80 percent of its cell width and stay wholly inside. NO complete character, NO extra floating ornaments, NO duplicated parts. Output a professional clean transparent flat-color sprite parts atlas, exactly the six requested pieces, ready for segmentation and SVG tracing.
